verdict.rationale: A direct probe found an OpenAPI document at https://workos.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key), so a machine-readable API spec is publicly downloadable. Machine-readable docs (llms.txt, docs.md) back this up, though they are not API specs themselves. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that announces or explains the spec (version, coverage of all endpoints), and independent confirmation of its completeness and freshness.
